title: Detailed donut
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Donut base - golden brown -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="40" fill="#D4943A"/>
  <!-- Lighter inner ring for depth -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="38" fill="#E8A94E"/>
  <!-- Donut hole -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="14" fill="#1A1A2E"/>
  <!-- Hole inner edge highlight -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="15" fill="none" stroke="#C47F2A" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Pink frosting - uneven drip edge -->
  <path d="M 50 12 
    C 68 12, 84 22, 87 38 
    C 89 46, 86 52, 84 55 
    C 82 58, 80 56, 78 60 
    C 76 64, 78 68, 74 68 
    C 70 68, 71 62, 67 63 
    C 63 64, 64 70, 60 70 
    C 56 70, 56 64, 52 64 
    C 48 64, 48 70, 44 70 
    C 40 70, 41 64, 37 63 
    C 33 62, 34 68, 30 68 
    C 26 68, 28 64, 26 60 
    C 24 56, 22 58, 20 55 
    C 18 52, 15 46, 17 38 
    C 20 22, 32 12, 50 12 Z" 
    fill="#F06B9A"/>
  
  <!-- Frosting highlight -->
  <path d="M 50 16 
    C 64 16, 78 24, 81 38 
    C 82 44, 80 48, 78 51 
    C 76 54, 74 53, 73 56 
    C 72 59, 73 62, 70 62 
    C 67 62, 68 58, 65 58 
    C 62 58, 62 63, 59 63 
    C 56 63, 56 58, 53 58 
    C 50 58, 50 63, 47 63 
    C 44 63, 44 58, 41 58 
    C 38 58, 38 63, 35 63 
    C 32 63, 33 59, 31 56 
    C 29 53, 27 54, 26 51 
    C 24 48, 22 44, 23 38 
    C 26 24, 36 16, 50 16 Z" 
    fill="#F58BAF"/>
  
  <!-- Frosting shine spots -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="25" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#F9A8C9" transform="rotate(-20 40 25)"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="24" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#F9A8C9" transform="rotate(15 62 24)"/>
  
  <!-- Sprinkles -->
  <rect x="35" y="30" width="6" height="2.5" rx="1.25" fill="#4DD8E8" transform="rotate(-30 38 31.25)"/>
  <rect x="52" y="20" width="6" height="2.5" rx="1.25" fill="#FFE04D" transform="rotate(45 55 21.25)"/>
  <rect x="65" y="32" width="6" height="2.5" rx="1.25" fill="#7CE84D" transform="rotate(-15 68 33.25)"/>
  <rect x="25" y="42" width="6" height="2.5" rx="1.25" fill="#E84D7C" transform="rotate(60 28 43.25)"/>
  <rect x="72" y="42" width="6" height="2.5" rx="1.25" fill="#4D7CFF" transform="rotate(-50 75 43.25)"/>
  <rect x="45" y="34" width="6" height="2.5" rx="1.25" fill="#FFA04D" transform="rotate(20 48 35.25)"/>
  <rect x="58" y="40" width="6" height="2.5" rx="1.25" fill="#E84DE8" transform="rotate(-40 61 41.25)"/>
  <rect x="32" y="50" width="6" height="2.5" rx="1.25" fill="#4DD8E8" transform="rotate(10 35 51.25)"/>
  <rect x="68" y="52" width="6" height="2.5" rx="1.25" fill="#FFE04D" transform="rotate(-70 71 53.25)"/>
  <rect x="44" y="44" width="6" height="2.5" rx="1.25" fill="#7CE84D" transform="rotate(80 47 45.25)"/>
  <rect x="55" y="48" width="6" height="2.5" rx="1.25" fill="#E84D7C" transform="rotate(-25 58 49.25)"/>
  <rect x="22" y="34" width="5" height="2.2" rx="1.1" fill="#FFA04D" transform="rotate(35 24.5 35.1)"/>
  <rect x="76" y="34" width="5" height="2.2" rx="1.1" fill="#E84DE8" transform="rotate(-55 78.5 35.1)"/>
  
  <!-- Donut bottom shadow edge -->
  <path d="M 20 58 C 25 72, 35 84, 50 86 C 65 84, 75 72, 80 58" 
    fill="none" stroke="#B87828" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
